nodes.name: FileLoadMixin._start_a2l_load
nodes.func: preserves admission and recent decisions, begins the busy run, creates the frozen request without generation/image snapshot fields and starts the attach worker
examples: (E4-030-2) image map with one source byte changed after request capture → request keeps independent read-only original bytes and expected pair
(E4-033-6) image bytes `1000000`; two keys during request capture → each acknowledgement latency at most `1.0` s
(E4-034-4) image bytes `1000000` during request capture → visible progress gaps at most `1.0` s

nodes.name: FileLoadMixin._a2l_attach_worker
nodes.func: copies when requested, parses with byte progress, constructs the current parsed result and dispatches install or failure; current code performs no enrichment or definition preparation
examples: (E4-029-1) typed NEW attach → worker completes enriched tags, summary and two picker snapshots before install dispatch
(E4-037-1) OLD measurable names → Check describe count `1` and Patch describe count `1`, both off UI
(E4-033-3) held enrichment and two keys → each key acknowledged within `1.0` s before install
(E4-034-1) enrichment held `1.5` s → every visible progress gap at most `1.0` s
(E4-038-1) enrichment raises ValueError → exact File NOT loaded outcome and no install
(E4-038-2) real enrichment completes then render_a2l_view raises ValueError → exact File NOT loaded outcome and no describe or install

nodes.name: FileLoadMixin._install_attached_a2l
nodes.func: currently records recents, refreshes files, stores cache and A2L, attaches to the current file, runs common refresh and schedules success without a direct-snapshot generation preflight
examples: (E4-031-1) matching OLD result without an image → enrichment key (new A2L, unchanged image, `-1`) before refresh
(E4-031-2) matching NEW result over IMG1 → enrichment key (new A2L, unchanged image, independently measured image map size) before refresh
(E4-032-1) stale A2L generation → Load superseded — current state kept. with zero install or refresh
(E4-035-2) accepted replacement → install then one UI common refresh then A2L loaded outcome
(E4-036-2) accepted image-bearing snapshot → worker enrichment count `1` and UI enrichment count `0`

nodes.name: A2LParameterPicker.set_parameters
nodes.func: currently no-ops on equal non-None signature and otherwise performs one direct bulk describe before normalizing rows and rebuilding one page
examples: (E4-037-2) same-path NEW generation with declared length `8` and format f32 → one supplied worker snapshot paints length `8` and f32 without a UI describe
(E4-037-3) twenty filter/page rebuilds plus unchanged signature → additional describe count `0` and page rows at most `200`

nodes.name: CheckEditorPanel.set_a2l_parameters
nodes.func: currently forwards rows, signature and the app's current A2L payload to the Check picker, then preserves picks and refreshes layout/previews after real population
examples: (E4-037-1) accepted OLD direct generation → Check consumes its own matching worker definitions and paints exact declared lengths/formats
(E4-037-4) wrong A2L source or full signature → accepted mapping invalidated before existing-route describe and no stale definitions painted
(E4-037-3) unchanged Check signature → repopulated False with preserved filter/page/picks and zero describes

nodes.name: A2lPickerMixin.set_a2l_parameters
nodes.func: currently forwards rows, signature and the app's current A2L payload to the Patch picker, then invalidates and reapplies layout after real population
examples: (E4-037-2) same-path NEW direct generation → Patch consumes a distinct matching worker snapshot and paints f32, never the OLD u16 definition
(E4-037-4) wrong A2L source or full signature → accepted mapping invalidated before existing-route describe and no stale definitions painted
(E4-037-3) Patch filter/page rebuilds → additional describe count `0` and current NEW definitions retained

entities.name: [Data: A2L busy run]
entities.desc: existing main-thread progress state; copy/parse byte progress and spinner/elapsed remain visible throughout processing

entities.name: [I/O: workarea A2L copy]
entities.desc: existing worker copy; a stale install preflight does not turn an already copied file into installed session state

entities.name: [Data: Current A2L]
entities.desc: current path and parsed payload owned by the existing single-writer replacement seam

entities.name: [Data: A2L view caches]
entities.desc: enriched tags, summary lines and the existing A2L/image/mem-size key installed before common refresh

entities.name: [Data: Picker population]
entities.desc: shared picker's current rows, definitions, A2L source, filter, page and picks

entities.name: [Data: Check picker population]
entities.desc: Check adapter's embedded picker and its existing selection/layout side effects

entities.name: [Data: Patch picker population]
entities.desc: Patch adapter's embedded picker and its existing layout side effects
